{{Top|leg}}
The '''Veerpal Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Noble Calder]], they escorted the [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] ''[[Aremin]]'' over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Redcap]]. Here, they [[Skirmish at Redcap|engaged]] the deluded [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toob Ancher]] in a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].<ref name="ABW">{{JournalCite|5|A Bitter Winter}}</ref>
